name: normalize_req_ids_smoke
description: Reads {records:[{document,originalId}]} on stdin, normalizes originalId to canonical PREFIX-NNNN (REQ/SEC/R/S, 4-digit padded), returns {records, collisions}; reports collisions, never deduplicates. No file I/O, network, or process effects.
capabilityGap: No installed tool or Academy candidate deterministically normalizes heterogeneous requirement/section identifiers to canonical form and reports canonical-ID collisions from a CSV.

outcome.observedResult: Normalized all 8 CSV rows to canonical PREFIX-NNNN IDs; output deep-equal to examples/09-pi-runtime-smoke/expected/normalized.json (records + collisions). Reported 2 canonical-ID collisions (REQ-0012: 'REQ 12' + 'req-0012'; SEC-0007: 'SEC.7' + 'sec 0007') without deduplicating. Input file SHA-256 unchanged (2b933dd2...).
limitations: Prefix set is closed (REQUIREMENT/REQ/SECTION/SEC/R/S); unknown prefixes raise instead of guessing
Collisions are reported globally across documents; same canonical ID reused within one document is not distinguished
CSV parsing is a minimal line/split parser; quoted fields with embedded commas are not supported
Output order follows input order; no stability guarantees across reordered inputs for collision source lists
outcome.reuseHypothesis: Document-to-requirement mapping and cross-document reconciliation tasks repeatedly face heterogeneous requirement/section ID formats; a canonicalization + collision-reporting step is a reusable preprocessing capability for RAG ingestion, spec comparison, and contract reconciliation workflows.
